name: monday
description: Reads monday.com GraphQL streams and plans fixed bounded query operations; models typed Monday GraphQL mutations for reverse ETL through named actions with approval gates.

risk.read: external monday.com GraphQL API reads; ETL streams remain executable, while fixed query operations are planned until shared GraphQL errors[] and duplicate POST / classifier handling lands
risk.write: typed monday.com GraphQL mutations through named reverse-ETL actions only; complex-input mutations remain planned/blocked instead of raw GraphQL
risk.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute; destructive/admin actions require typed destructive confirmation
